info.title: PoYo AI - Seedance 2 API
info.description: The Seedance 2 API generates a 4–15 second video from text, up to two frames, or image, video, and audio references. A faster variant is limited to 480p and 720p.

post.description: Generate videos using Seedance 2 or Seedance 2 Fast with text-to-video, first and last frame, and multimodal reference workflows.

input.prompt: A cinematic drone shot flying over a neon city after rain, reflections shimmering on the streets
A fast-paced tracking shot through a cyberpunk alley with glowing signs and drifting mist
A smooth transition from sunrise to golden afternoon over a mountain lake
A stylish fashion short with energetic pacing, matching the movement rhythm of the reference clip

BearerAuth.description:
All API endpoints require Bearer Token authentication.

Create an API key: sign in to PoYo, open **Dashboard → API Key** at [poyo.ai/dashboard/api-key](https://poyo.ai/dashboard/api-key), and click to create a key.

Add it to the request header:

```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

model.description: Seedance 2 model identifier. Use `seedance-2` for the standard variant or `seedance-2-fast` for faster, lower-cost generation.

callback_url.description: Webhook callback URL for result notifications

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the target video. Must be between 3 and 20,000 characters.
prompt.example: A cinematic drone shot flying over a neon city after rain

image_urls.description: Optional first and last frame images for image-to-video mode. Provide 1 or 2 publicly accessible image URLs. Index 0 is mapped to the starting frame and index 1 is mapped to the optional ending frame. Supported image formats are JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, and AVIF; each image should be up to 30 MB. Cannot be used together with any reference_*_urls fields.

reference_image_urls.description: Optional reference image URLs for multimodal reference-to-video mode. Supports up to 9 publicly accessible images. Supported image formats are JPG, JPEG, PNG, and WebP; each image should be up to 30 MB. You can reference images in the prompt by order, such as @Image1 or @Image2. Cannot be used together with image_urls.

reference_video_urls.description: Optional reference video URLs for multimodal reference-to-video mode. Supports up to 3 publicly accessible MP4 or MOV files. The combined reference video duration should be 2 to 15 seconds total, total video size should be under 50 MB, and each video should be 480p to 720p. You can reference videos in the prompt by order, such as @Video1 or @Video2. Cannot be used together with image_urls.

reference_audio_urls.description: Optional reference audio URLs for multimodal reference-to-video mode. Supports up to 3 publicly accessible MP3 or WAV files. The combined reference audio duration should not exceed 15 seconds, and each file should be up to 15 MB. Audio references require at least one reference image or reference video. You can reference audio files in the prompt by order, such as @Audio1 or @Audio2. Cannot be used together with image_urls.

generate_audio.description: Whether to generate an audio track.

resolution.description: Output resolution. `seedance-2` supports `480p`, `720p`, `1080p`, and `4k`. `seedance-2-fast` supports `480p` and `720p` only.

duration.description: Video duration in seconds. Supported values are integers from 4 to 15.

code.description:
Business status code. `200` means success; any other value means the request failed. Always check this field: some validation errors return HTTP 200 with `code: 400` in the body.

- `200`: Success
- `400`: Invalid request parameters
- `401`: Missing or invalid API key
- `402`: Insufficient credits
- `403`: Permission denied
- `404`: Resource not found
- `408`: Request timeout
- `429`: Rate limit exceeded
- `500`: Internal server error
- `502`: Upstream service error
- `503`: Service unavailable

See [Error Codes](/api-manual/error-codes) for details.

task_id.description: Unique task identifier for status tracking

status.description:
Task status. Always `not_started` right after submission. Use [Query Task Status](/api-manual/task-management/status) or `callback_url` to get later states.

- `not_started`: Queued, waiting to be processed
- `running`: Being generated
- `finished`: Completed; results are in `files` or `output`
- `failed`: Failed; details are in `error_message`

created_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the task was created
